parameters.query: WITH claimed AS (UPDATE helpdesk.notification_outbox SET status='sending', attempts=attempts+1, last_error_code=NULL WHERE outbox_id IN (SELECT outbox_id FROM helpdesk.notification_outbox WHERE status IN ('pending','failed') AND attempts < 3 ORDER BY created_at FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 10) RETURNING outbox_id,ticket_id,idempotency_key,notification_type,attempts) SELECT c.outbox_id,c.ticket_id,c.idempotency_key,c.notification_type,c.attempts,t.requester_email,t.subject,t.correlation_id FROM claimed c JOIN helpdesk.tickets t ON t.ticket_id=c.ticket_id;

UPDATE helpdesk.notification_outbox SET status='failed', last_error_code='smtp_delivery_failed' WHERE outbox_id=$1::uuid AND status='sending' RETURNING outbox_id,ticket_id,attempts;

WITH resolved AS (UPDATE helpdesk.review_tasks SET status='resolved',resolution=$2,resolved_by=$3,resolved_at=now(),updated_at=now() WHERE review_task_id=$1::uuid AND status IN ('open','claimed') RETURNING ticket_id), updated_ticket AS (UPDATE helpdesk.tickets t SET status=CASE WHEN $2='route' THEN 'routed' ELSE 'failed' END,assigned_queue=CASE WHEN $2='route' THEN $4 ELSE 'manual_review' END,needs_human_review=false,updated_at=now() FROM resolved r WHERE t.ticket_id=r.ticket_id RETURNING t.ticket_id,t.correlation_id), event AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.ticket_events (ticket_id,event_type,actor,correlation_id,metadata) SELECT ticket_id,CASE WHEN $2='route' THEN 'human_review_routed' ELSE 'human_review_rejected' END,$3,correlation_id,jsonb_build_object('assigned_queue',$4) FROM updated_ticket) SELECT ticket_id,correlation_id FROM updated_ticket;

INSERT INTO helpdesk.failed_jobs (ticket_id,stage,failure_class,error_code,attempt_count,next_retry_at,terminal,replay_context,idempotency_key) VALUES (COALESCE($1::uuid,(SELECT ticket_id FROM helpdesk.tickets WHERE idempotency_key=$8)), $2,$3,$4,0,$5::timestamptz,$6,$7::jsonb,$8) RETURNING failed_job_id,ticket_id,stage,terminal;

INSERT INTO helpdesk.ticket_events (ticket_id,event_type,actor,correlation_id,metadata) SELECT t.ticket_id,'workflow_failed','workflow:helpdesk-error-capture',t.correlation_id,jsonb_build_object('failed_job_id',$2::uuid,'stage',$3,'terminal',$4::boolean) FROM helpdesk.tickets t WHERE t.ticket_id=$1::uuid RETURNING event_id;
UPDATE helpdesk.notification_outbox SET status='pending',attempts=0,last_error_code=NULL WHERE idempotency_key=$1 AND ticket_id=$2::uuid AND status='failed' RETURNING outbox_id;

UPDATE helpdesk.failed_jobs SET attempt_count=attempt_count+1,next_retry_at=NULL,terminal=(attempt_count+1>=3) WHERE failed_job_id=$1::uuid AND terminal=false AND resolved_at IS NULL AND attempt_count<3 AND replay_context->>'version'='1' AND replay_context->>'idempotency_key' ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$' RETURNING failed_job_id,ticket_id,stage,idempotency_key,attempt_count,terminal;
SELECT ticket_id,correlation_id,idempotency_key,requester_email,subject,description,created_at FROM helpdesk.tickets WHERE idempotency_key=$1 AND ticket_id=$2::uuid;
UPDATE helpdesk.failed_jobs SET resolved_at=now(),terminal=true WHERE failed_job_id=$1::uuid AND resolved_at IS NULL RETURNING failed_job_id;

WITH detected AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.sla_breaches (ticket_id) SELECT t.ticket_id FROM helpdesk.tickets t WHERE t.status IN ('received','processing','routed','manual_review') AND t.sla_deadline IS NOT NULL AND t.sla_deadline < now() ON CONFLICT (ticket_id) DO NOTHING RETURNING ticket_id), events AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.ticket_events (ticket_id,event_type,actor,correlation_id,metadata) SELECT t.ticket_id,'sla_breached','workflow:helpdesk-sla-monitor',t.correlation_id,jsonb_build_object('sla_deadline',t.sla_deadline) FROM detected d JOIN helpdesk.tickets t ON t.ticket_id=d.ticket_id), outbox AS (INSERT INTO helpdesk.notification_outbox (ticket_id,idempotency_key,notification_type) SELECT d.ticket_id,encode(digest('sla_breach:' || d.ticket_id::text,'sha256'),'hex'),'sla_breach' FROM detected d ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO NOTHING RETURNING outbox_id,ticket_id) SELECT outbox_id,ticket_id FROM outbox;

parameters.content: ## 01 — Intake and validation\n\nPOST intake: validates, persists the durable receipt, and starts classification/routing.
## 02 — AI classification\n\nBuilds a fixed prompt, calls internal Ollama, and validates the model contract.
## 03 — Routing, SLA, and persistence\n\nApplies deterministic safety/routing/SLA rules and persists ticket, audit, review, and outbox data.
## 04 — Notification worker\n\nScheduled worker: claims outbox rows, sends Mailpit messages, retries, and captures exhausted failures.
## 05 — Human review\n\nReviewer webhook: validates a decision, resolves the task, updates the ticket, and audits it.
## 06 — Error capture / dead letter\n\nSanitizes a failed stage and stores bounded replay context plus a ticket audit event.
## 07 — Failed-job reprocessing\n\nReviewer-triggered replay: atomically claims a job and restarts classification/routing or resets a notification.
## 08 — SLA breach monitor\n\nScheduled monitor: detects each elapsed SLA once, audits it, and queues one escalation notification.
